command.name: security key-manager external gcp update-credentials
command.description: This command allows the user to update the application credential which is used by the Google Cloud Key Management Service (GCKMS) configured for the given Vserver. The application credential is initially set by running the security key-manager external gcp enable command. This command will fail if GCKMS has not been enabled for the Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver for which the GCKMS application credential will be updated.

example.p: The following example updates the GCKMS application credential for the data Vserver v1.
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager external gcp update-credentials -vserver v1
Enter the new application credential: Press <Enter> when done
